callees.name: _optional_string
callees.pre_condition: value is the result of a dict key lookup — either a string or a default value (e.g., empty string) substituted when the key is missing. label identifies the field name for error context. source is a provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns the string value when value is a non-empty string. Returns an empty string when value is absent or empty. Raises ValueError whose message contains source and label when value is present but has a type other than string.

callees.name: _string_list
callees.pre_condition: value is the result of a dict key lookup expected to be a sequence of strings. label identifies the field name for error context. source is a provenance string.
callees.post_condition: Returns a tuple of strings extracted from value when value is a valid sequence of strings. Raises ValueError whose message contains source and label when value is present but is not a valid sequence of strings.

callees.name: normalize_fqn_label
callees.pre_condition: label is a non-empty string in file-path notation representing a FQN (e.g., 'path/to/file.c::func').
callees.post_condition: Returns the label with path-segment separators ('/') replaced by FM-Agent FQN separators ('::') and the file-extension dot before the function separator replaced by a hyphen, yielding the canonical form (e.g., 'path::to::file-c::func').

callees.name: CallerSelector
callees.pre_condition: fqn is a (possibly empty) string. callsite_names is a (possibly empty) tuple of strings.
callees.post_condition: Returns a frozen CallerSelector instance holding the given fqn and callsite_names values.
